title: Video-Text Search
description: I explored retrieving video clips with natural-language queries by learning a shared space for video and text. The system pairs ResNet50 and BERT with contrastive learning, with ONNX export and a Rust API backed by Weaviate.

title: Ghostwriter
description: I compared recurrent models, including LSTMs, with causal Transformers on next-token prediction in PyTorch. I also explored contrastive song embeddings and built a local playground to inspect how prompts and sampling settings affect generation.

title: ML projects
description: Smaller experiments covering sentiment classification, recommendations, click-through rate prediction, and feature pipelines. These projects explore how model choices, evaluation, and the surrounding data systems fit together.
